283753398.description:
Large Rock Mineral Collection Bundle Good and Beautiful Educational Box
This large rock and mineral collection bundle includes the Good and Beautiful branded educational specimen box with 9 labeled compartments featuring igneous, sedimentary, metamorphic, and mineral samples such as mica, quartz, and pyrite. Also included is a French-labeled display case with 24 compartments containing various tumbled and raw stones like Microcline, Labradorite, Cornaline, Jaspe, Amazonite, Rhodonite, Calcite, Dolomie, Gabbro, and Apatite in a bamboo-framed glass-covered box. Additionally, there is a large loose assortment of approximately 40+ raw and polished stones and minerals, including lava rock, amethyst cluster, turquoise-colored stone, tiger's eye, petrified wood, onyx/calcite slab, rutilated quartz, and various jaspers and agates. Items show typical used and handled condition consistent with an educational or hobbyist rock collection. Specimens vary in size from small chips to palm-sized pieces. This collection is suitable for geology enthusiasts, collectors, or educational purposes.
